answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 17 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 504 identities costs 504 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The ocean of the design is public, the lotus of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the marble of honest work is what finally pays.
